findings.title: Interactive package rows lose button semantics
findings.detail: Each clickable button inside the package list is assigned role="listitem". This overrides the native button role for assistive technology, so the row is exposed as a list item rather than an actionable button. Remove the explicit role from the button (or use a separate listitem wrapper) while retaining keyboard activation and selected-state exposure.
